text: Macau is a **Special Administrative Region of China**, so for country streaks purposes, it is counted as China.
text_zh: 澳門是中國的**特別行政區**，所以在國家連勝的計算中，它被算作中國。

text: Coverage in Macau is limited to **Generation 2**.
Generation 2 can be recognized by the lower camera quality and circular blur above and below the camera. Colours will also seem slightly off.

The coverage in Macau specifically is some of the oldest Generation 2 available, meaning that the colours look even more **washed out** and overexposed than usual. This can be a great way to identify the Macau coverage in the absence of other clues.
text_zh: 澳門的街景覆蓋僅限於**第 2 代**。
第 2 代可以透過較差的相機畫質以及相機上下方的圓形模糊來辨識。顏色看起來也會稍微失真。
澳門特有的覆蓋是現存最古老的第 2 代街景之一，這意味著顏色看起來比平常更**褪色**且過度曝光。在沒有其他線索的情況下，這可以是辨識澳門覆蓋的好方法。

text: Macau uses **black** licence plates with **white** text. Licence plates can either be long or square.
text_zh: 澳門使用**黑色**車牌配上**白色**文字。車牌可以是長形或方形。

text: Cylindrical grey lamp posts with a **black painted bottom** can be seen in Macau.
NOTE: Similar lamp posts can be seen in Hong Kong, however they do not have a black painted bottom.
text_zh: 在澳門可以看到底部漆成**黑色**的圓柱形灰色燈柱。
注意：香港也能看到類似的燈柱，但它們底部沒有漆成黑色。

text: Due to Macau’s history as a Portuguese colony, **Portuguese language** can commonly be seen, especially on storefronts, along with Chinese.
text_zh: 由於澳門作為葡萄牙殖民地的歷史，經常可以看到**葡萄牙語**，特別是在店面招牌上，並伴隨中文。

text: These **white** street signs with a **blue border** around the Chinese and Portuguese text are unique to Macau.
text_zh: 這些在中葡文周圍帶有**藍色邊框**的**白色**街道標誌是澳門獨有的。

text: **Gambling** is legal in Macau and its biggest source of revenue (50% of its GDP). As a result, you will see a lot of casinos and advertisements for gambling. The casinos often have very extravagant, kitsch designs.
Due to how old the Generation 2 is, many newer casinos can be seen [under construction](https://goo.gl/maps/sQsjXjEBhpx79hV77).
text_zh: **博彩業**在澳門是合法的，也是其最大的收入來源（佔其 GDP 的 50%）。因此，你會看到許多賭場和博彩廣告。這些賭場通常有非常誇張、俗氣的設計。
由於第 2 代的年代久遠，可以看到許多較新的賭場[正在建設中](https://goo.gl/maps/sQsjXjEBhpx79hV77)。

text: **Dense** apartment buildings with gridded, **narrow streets** and cars parked on both sides can be found in this region in the northern half of Macau.
text_zh: 在這個位於澳門北部半部的地區，可以找到網格狀、**狹窄街道**且兩側停滿車輛的**密集**公寓大樓。

text: A **hilly,** **rural** region of Macau can be found in the south. Roads are narrow, winding up hills with trees on both sides. A helpful clue are the lamp posts, which are commonly seen.

When this area appears in a world map, it can be confusing to newer players, as there are very few language or architecture clues available. The washed out early Generation 2 coverage can help with identifying it as being located in Macau.
text_zh: 在澳門南部可以找到一個**多山、** **鄉村風情**的地區。道路狹窄，蜿蜒上山，兩側都是樹木。一個有用的線索是經常可以看到的燈柱。
當這個地區出現在世界地圖上時，對於新玩家來說可能會感到困惑，因為可用的語言或建築線索非常少。早期褪色的第 2 代覆蓋可以幫助辨識其位於澳門。

text: The Sai Van Bridge can be recognized by these unique **cuboid towers** with **arches** in them.
text_zh: 西灣大橋可以透過這些帶有**拱門**的獨特**立方體塔樓**來辨識。

text: **Red** guardrails can be seen on the Amizade Bridge.
text_zh: 在友誼大橋上可以看到**紅色**護欄。
